title: Emission Detects the Language Indicator
statement: Let $M$ be a finite binary Turing machine, $L$ a binary language, $T:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ a time bound, and suppose $M$ decides $L$ within time $T$. For every binary word $x$, the Boolean decision of whether there is a time $s<T(|x|)$ at which the transition selected from the run's snapshot emits the bit $1$ equals the indicator of whether $x\in L$.
hypotheses_covered: $M$ is a finite Turing machine over the binary alphabet
